Reader label: Y
Date/time: Sun Nov 22 23:12:30 EST 2026
Images used (only these): blind_input/round2/no25/167R.jpg, 168L.jpg, 168R.jpg
Method: line crops at 1.6x, doubtful groups re-read at 2x-4x; transcribed blind (no key, table or other reading seen).

Notation:
  ?        after a number: unsure of this reading
  [a/b]    two possible readings
  ^        small mark above or after a number
  °        small circle above/after a number
  _+       small cross below
  _v       small tick below
  ~        small dash/tilde stroke standing between numbers (not a number)
  [illegible] number visible but not readable; [clipped] number cut off at the page/film edge
           (a digit or two before [clipped] = what is visible of it)
  |        vertical stroke in the ink between two numbers
  Full stops are copied as written. Lower-case words = ordinary English words standing inside the coded run.
  Line numbers are manuscript line numbers on each page.

== Reader remarks (general)
- In this hand 7 and 9 are both written with a descender and are easy to confuse; 5 and 6 at the end of 157x are also close. Where the shape was clear I wrote it plainly; where not, I gave [a/b] or ?.
- No washed-out areas on these three frames; the only losses are numbers clipped at the right film edge on 168L (lines 05, 07, 10, 22, 25).
